entries.title: I Chronicles 12:1
segments: And these [were] the ones who came to David to Ziklag, while banned from the face of Saul the son of Kish. And they [were] among the mighty men, helpers of the war,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:2
segments: right and left-handed, armed with bows, with stones, and with arrows, with the bow from the brothers of Saul, of Benjamin

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:3
segments: The chief [was] Ahiezer, and Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite, and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth, and Berachah, and Jehu of Anathoth

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:4
segments: and Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty, and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:5
segments: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:6
segments: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:7
segments: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:8
segments: And of the Gadites mighty men separated themselves to David into the stronghold in the wilderness, men of the army for battle, setting in order shield and buckler, and their faces [were] the faces of a lion, and as gazelles on the heights for swiftness:

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:9
segments: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:10
segments: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:11
segments: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:12
segments: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:13
segments: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:14
segments: These [were] the sons of Gad, captains of the army. One of the least [was] over a hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:15
segments: These [were] they who went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks. And they put all those of the valleys to flight, toward the east and toward the west.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:16
segments: And some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:17
segments: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, If you have come to me in peace, to help me, my heart shall be knit to you. But if you come to betray me to my enemies, since there is no wrong in my hands, let the God of our fathers look on it and rebuke it.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:18
segments: And the Spirit came on Amasai, chief of the Thirty. [And he said], We [are] yours, David, and on your side, son of Jesse. Peace, peace be on you, and peace on your helpers. For your God has helped you. And David received them and made them captains of the band.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:19
segments: And [some] from Manasseh fell to David when he came with the Philistines to battle against Saul. (But they did not help them. For the lords of the Philistines sent him away on advice, saying, He will fall to his master Saul with our heads.)

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:20
segments: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him these from Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of the thousands who [were] from Manasseh.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:21
segments: And they helped David against the band, for they [were] all mighty men of power, and [were] commanders in the army.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:22
segments: For at [that] time they came to David day by day to help him, until [it was] a great army, like an army of God.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:23
segments: And these [were] the numbers of the chiefs of those armed for war who came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:24
segments: The sons of Judah bearing shield and spear [were] six thousand and eight hundred, armed for war.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:25
segments: From the sons of Simeon the mighty men of power for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:26
segments: From the sons of Levi [were] four thousand and six hundred.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:27
segments: And Jehoiada [was] the leader of the Aaronites, and with him [were] three thousand and seven hundred.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:28
segments: And Zadok, a young man mighty in power, and of his fathers' house [were] twenty-two captains.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:29
segments: And the sons of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul [were] three thousand. And before, the most of them had kept their allegiance to the house of Saul.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:30
segments: And of the sons of Ephraim [were] twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:31
segments: And from the half tribe of Manasseh [were] eighteen thousand, who [were] chosen by name to come and make David king.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:32
segments: And from the sons of Issachar, [men] who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, the heads of them [were] two hundred. And all their brothers [were] at their command.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:33
segments: From Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all the weapons of war, fifty thousand who could keep rank. [They were] not of a double heart.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:34
segments: And from Naphtali, a thousand captains; and with them with shield and spear [were] thirty-seven thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:35
segments: And of the Danites, expert in war, [were] twenty-eight thousand, six hundred.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:36
segments: And of Asher, going out to the army to set in order the battle [were] forty thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:37
segments: And on the other side of Jordan, from the Reubenites, and of the Gadites, and from the half tribe of Manasseh, with all of the weapons of war for battle [were] a hundred and twenty thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:38
segments: All these [were] men of war, keeping rank, they came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over Israel. And also all the rest of Israel [was] of one heart to make David king.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:39
segments: And they [were] with David three days, eating and drinking. For their brothers had prepared food for them.

entries.title: I Chronicles 12:40
segments: And also those who were near them, even to Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen. And they brought food, meal, cakes of figs and bunches of raisins, and wine and oil, and oxen and sheep abundantly. For there [was] joy in Israel.
